about: Roles and titles as every client offers them (architecture 7.5): which settings sections an account sees, a role's lock and moves, a role editor's two drafts and when it saves, a member's form and what its save asks, what is offered of a member, the marks beside a name, the members' search, and every sentence said. `roles` names the lists of roles a case may use by name; `words` is every fixed sentence. Every client agrees on every case (lumia_client::roles).

words.ROLES_HINT: In order, highest first. Drag a role to move it. A new role starts last, just above Everyone.
words.ROLES_HINT_MENU: In order, highest first. A role is moved from its menu. A new role starts last, just above Everyone.
words.EVERYONE_SUBTITLE: What every member may do before any role adds to it. Guests are not among them.
words.TITLE_HINT: Up to 32 characters. A title grants nothing.
words.DELETE_ROLE_HINT: Its members lose what it allowed. This can’t be undone.
words.TAG_SUBTITLE: What shows beside a member’s name in messages and in the member list.
words.TAG_NOTE: A profile shows a member’s title and roles either way.
words.TAG_ROLES_CAPTION: Each member’s highest role that is shown as a tag, in the role’s colour.
words.TAG_TITLES_CAPTION: Each member’s title, in no colour. A member without a title has no tag.
words.EVERYONE_HOLDS: Everyone who can hold this role already does.
